key_decisions.decision: Bind title and royal praise; follow the read rejoicing form without adding new content.
Retain the expansive royal claim without reducing forever to merely long life.
Preserve direct address without forcing the uncertain king/God addressee.
Retain violent judgment and the shift from you to the LORD.
Keep the explicit destruction of descendants, with fruit as its parallel image.
